queries.descripcion_tematica: RQ1 - Modelado y caracterizacion dinamica del pH en clarificacion azucarera [Q1]
queries.query:
TS=(
  ("pH control" OR "pH monitoring" OR "pH prediction" OR "pH optimization"
   OR "pH regulation" OR "pH measurement" OR "pH adjustment" OR "pH correction"
   OR "acidity control" OR "alkalinity control" OR "juice acidity"
   OR "lime dosage" OR "lime addition" OR "calcium hydroxide" OR "milk of lime")
  AND
  ("sugar mill" OR "sugarcane" OR "cane juice" OR "sugar juice" OR "sugar industry"   # <--- AÑADIDO "sugar juice"
   OR "juice clarification" OR "liming process" OR "defecation" OR "sulfitation"
   OR "sugar beet" OR "beet sugar" OR "sugar factory" OR "saccharum")
  AND
  ("soft sensor" OR "virtual sensor" OR "inferential sensor"
   OR "identification" OR "data-driven model" OR "data-driven"
   OR "online estimation" OR "real-time estimation"
   OR "neural network" OR "LSTM" OR "predictive model" OR "regression model")
)

  "wastewater" OR "water treatment" OR "soil pH" OR "blood pH"
  OR "fermentation broth" OR "bioethanol" OR "pharmaceutical"
  OR "bioreactor" OR "wine" OR "beer" OR "dairy" OR "groundwater"

       OR "liming process" OR "defecation" OR "sulfitation"
